source.title: Gated Relational Alignment via Confidence-based Distillation for Efficient VLMs
source.authors: Yanlong Chen; Amirhossein Habibian; Luca Benini; Yawei Li

record.file_problem: Full paper text is present. Some figure text in the deployment-efficiency appendix is garbled, but this does not affect the findings recorded here.
record.tranche_reason: The study uses relational CKA to transfer visual-token structure from teacher to student as part of a compression method. It does not test whether independently trained models naturally become more aligned as they scale, or whether their representations are interchangeable without the induced distillation.
record.gate_note: The paper qualitatively compares within-model visual-token similarity patterns at different model sizes. These results describe semantic structure inside each model, not convergence between models. Its RCKA training results are induced by the method and do not report a direct measure of inter-model alignment.
record.test_reason: GRACE is a distillation and quantization method that induces teacher-student alignment of visual-token relational structure through an RCKA loss. It reports only benchmark accuracy and efficiency of its own method. No measure of inter-model representational similarity between independently trained models is reported, either across scale, across modalities, across seeds, or via mapping. The 2B vs 7B similarity maps are within-model, qualitative, and concern how well each model organizes its own tokens, not convergence between models.
record.authors_conclusion: The paraphrase is correct. The authors conclude that GRACE (confidence-gated DKD, relational CKA, adaptive IB controller, group-wise LSQ) lets INT4 VLM students surpass BF16 baselines and approach their teachers, with real speed and memory gains. They make no claim about spontaneous convergence between models.
record.recipe_differences: The study trains quantized teacher-student VLMs using confidence-gated distillation and relational CKA, rather than testing the original claim’s inter-model convergence with scale.

fits_no_version.finding: In bear and airplane examples, Qwen2-VL 7B shows sharper within-image visual-token similarity clusters than 2B. In LLaVA-1.5, 13B attention is more focused than 7B.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Larger VLMs show sharper semantic organization of within-image visual-token similarity and attention (qualitative, few examples).

record.peer_reviewed: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306, 2026
record.problems: The relevant model-scale comparisons are qualitative visual examples, not numerical convergence measurements, and do not establish a general scale trend. The paper's main RCKA results concern a training-induced teacher-student alignment objective.
record.rows_left_out: No additional eligible inter-model convergence results were reported. The paper's attention-map comparisons and RCKA-induced training visualizations are not direct measurements of inter-model representation alignment.

untested.parts: Whether independently trained models' representations align more with scale; no inter-model similarity reported.
No mapping or stitching quality between independently trained models. RCKA alignment is induced by training and no post-training CKA value is reported.
No cross-model feature or circuit comparison.
No test of metric or input dependence of convergence.
No test of plateau or the causes of alignment.

record.verdict_notes: The study is out of scope (T4). The record's relation, tranche and rows are accurate; no verdicts are given.

versions.untested_parts: Whether independently trained models become more aligned with scale and capability, particularly across different architectures, objectives, or data.
No alignment measurement between vision and language model representations of paired images and captions.
No comparison of models trained from different random initializations.
RCKA is used to train a student toward a teacher, but the study does not test interchangeability or mapping quality as a result independent of that induced training.
No recurring features or circuits are compared across models.
No test of how inter-model convergence changes with similarity metrics, their settings, or input distributions.
No test of whether inter-model alignment plateaus, remains incomplete, or is explained by shared data or objectives.

rows.subject: Qwen2-VL 2B
rows.operation_detail: Visualizes pairwise cosine similarities among visual tokens within an image.
rows.measure: Qualitative within-model visual-token similarity pattern and semantic-boundary clarity.
rows.baseline: Compared with Qwen2-VL 7B on the same image.
rows.value: Similarity patterns are described as diffuse and noisy; the center-token map has scattered activations that do not cleanly separate the bear from the background.
rows.locator: Appendix C.1, Figure 8 and accompanying text
rows.note: This is a within-model token-similarity result, not a measurement of alignment between the 2B and 7B representations.
rows.check: This is a qualitative within-model token-similarity map. It is not an inter-model alignment measure, so its link to no version is correct.

rows.subject: Qwen2-VL 7B
rows.operation_detail: Visualizes pairwise cosine similarities among visual tokens within an image.
rows.measure: Qualitative within-model visual-token similarity pattern and semantic-boundary clarity.
rows.baseline: Compared with Qwen2-VL 2B on the same image.
rows.value: The center-token map is described as having high similarity concentrated on the bear; grass and fence tokens form distinct, coherent clusters.
rows.locator: Appendix C.1, Figure 8 and accompanying text
rows.note: The text presents clearer semantic grouping at 7B, but does not quantify similarity between the two models.
rows.check: This is a qualitative within-model map. It does not quantify similarity between the 7B and 2B models.

rows.subject: Qwen2-VL 2B
rows.operation_detail: Visualizes pairwise cosine similarities among visual tokens within an image.
rows.measure: Qualitative within-model visual-token similarity pattern and separation of semantic regions.
rows.baseline: Compared with Qwen2-VL 7B on the same image.
rows.value: The model is described as producing mixed similarity values across semantic boundaries and struggling to distinguish the airplane, sky, and ground.
rows.locator: Appendix C.1, Figure 9 and accompanying text
rows.note: This reports within-model token relations, not inter-model convergence.
rows.check: This is a qualitative within-model map. It is not a convergence measure.

rows.subject: Qwen2-VL 7B
rows.operation_detail: Visualizes pairwise cosine similarities among visual tokens within an image.
rows.measure: Qualitative within-model visual-token similarity pattern and separation of semantic regions.
rows.baseline: Compared with Qwen2-VL 2B on the same image.
rows.value: Sky, airplane, and ground are described as clearly separated; the center-token activation map closely follows the aircraft shape.
rows.locator: Appendix C.1, Figure 9 and accompanying text
rows.note: The described improvement concerns semantic organization inside the 7B model, not measured alignment with the 2B model.
rows.check: This is a qualitative within-model map. It is not a convergence measure.
